items.name: Falchion
items.description: This weapon is a heavier, two-handed version of the curved-bladed scimitar. It is weighted toward the blade's end, making it a powerful slashing weapon.

items.name: Full Plate
items.description: Plate mail consists of interlocking plates that encase nearly the entire body in a carapace of steel. It is costly and heavy, and the wearer often requires help to don it correctly, but it provides some of the best defense armor can supply. A suit of this armor comes with an undercoat of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Padded Armor] and a pair of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Gauntlet]{gauntlets}.

defensiveAbilities.name: Armored Disguise
defensiveAbilities.description: A Blisterwell oathrisen's undead nature is not obvious. While wearing armor, an oathrisen gains a +4 circumstance bonus to its Deception checks to Impersonate a living orc and does not require a disguise kit to do so. Creatures that don't notice the disguise are not subject to the oathrisen's Frightful Presence. An oathrisen can abandon its disguise as a free action with the manipulate trait when it attempts to Demoralize a creature.

defensiveAbilities.name: Drop the Mask
defensiveAbilities.description: Once a Blisterwell oathrisen is reduced to less than half its Hit Points, portions of its armor break off. This reduces its AC by 2, increases its Speed by 5 feet, and gives it weakness 5 to vitality damage. This also immediately exposes nearby creatures to the oathrisen's frightful presence.

defensiveAbilities.name: Frightful Presence
defensiveAbilities.description:
30 feet DC 25 Will Saving Throw

See rules...

A creature that first enters the area must attempt a Will save.

Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is temporarily immune to this monster's Frightful Presence for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected by the presence.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Frightened 4.

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Curse of Whispers
offensiveAbilities.description:
A creature muffled by this curse cannot speak above a whisper. The creature must succeed at a DC 25 Fortitude Saving Throw save to use actions with the auditory trait

Saving Throw DC 25 Will Saving Throw

Stage 1 muffled for 1 minute (1 minute)

Stage 2 muffled for 1 minute (1 minute)

Stage 3 muffled for 1 day (1 day)

offensiveAbilities.name: Wound Ripper
offensiveAbilities.description: A Blisterwell oathrisen's Strikes against creatures with the Wounded condition or taking persistent bleed damage deal 1d6 additional precision damage.
